scope: The sole primary member is the complete retained ThML document. Preserve its complete header and document-shell inventory, all eight ordered top-level div1 roots, and every body descendant; no neighboring CCEL work is in scope.
body_policy: Every supported body element is projected once in source order to standard TEI. Preserve exact direct text and child tails. The independent reader separately enumerates all source body elements and all TEI body elements, then compares order, shape, source IDs, significant source attributes, text, and tails.
attribute_policy: Record every source element attribute exactly in source-accountability.json. Map source IDs to xml:id, links and scripture targets without normalization, note place/number, and source presentation classes/styles to TEI rend/type where applicable. Navigation title/progress/prev/next attributes remain source metadata and do not establish edition or part identity.
shell_policy: Record the XML declaration, external DOCTYPE identifiers, prolog/epilog nodes, processing instructions, comments, and complete ThML.head element inventory. The external DTD is never fetched. Non-body comments and processing instructions are accounted for but not emitted as TEI content.
metadata_policy: Preserve provider-record title, creator, publisher, record-created date, language, subjects, description, empty source/rights fields, and all other header values as source observations. Do not infer print edition, publication year, translator, rights clearance, or canonical part/witness boundaries.
